# Performance Participation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:PerformanceParticipation`](gmeow-PerformanceParticipation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/PerformanceParticipation>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)

A reified participation in a musical event — a performance, recording session, take, overdub, rehearsal, or transmission. Adds music-specific details (instrument type, specific instrument item, configuration, part, technique) to the universal [`gmeow:Participation`](gmeow-Participation.md) relator. Playing bass on take 3 is event involvement expressed here, not a third relator (Principles 4, 9).
